data.title: 德尔塔 · 祭典水盆前的大狗扑鱼
data.description: 四越夜市捞金鱼摊位前，红纸灯笼光辉下，德尔塔咬着烤肉签蹲在水盆旁，毛茸茸的大狗尾巴剧烈摇晃，两眼放光盯着游动的小鱼。
data.location: vibrant festival stall alley with red paper lanterns and wooden water tubs
data.action: crouched low before a shallow water tank, wagging dog tail rapidly, clutching a paper scoop while watching goldfishes with intense wide sparkling eyes
data.lighting: 红纸灯笼与水波暖红倒影
data.promptProse: Delta crouches enthusiastically beside a festival goldfish tub in her festive happi, tail wagging into a blur as she zeroes in on swimming fish.
data.animaCaption: Red lantern reflections ripple in the water basin as her dog tail wags with delight.
